question: Does a certified fusion still beat its sources when the seeds are re-randomized and the substrate changes?
residual_caveat: No estate production certified fusion exists on this worktree (estate scan). Confirmation applies to the local certified splice fixture. Presentation-order seeds and a redundant token did not move F1 after OOV-strip; that is evidence the win is not a seed artifact, not a skipped control.

rollback_repro.reason: No product-code mutation; fusion fixture is the object under test.

planted_worse_fusion.note: Planted union-all is worse than precision-router and recall-expander. weak-constant already scores 0 F1, so strict-worse-than-every-source is unsatisfiable on this metric.

title: Re-run a certified workflow fusion's benchmark win with re-randomized seeds on a different substrate
